sections.description:
Nadra (Application To The Federally Administered Tribal Areas)
Regulation 2005
Nadra
(Application To The Federally Administered Tribal
Areas) Regulation 2005
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 2nd August, 2005]
S.R.O. 754(I)/2005, dated 28-6-2005.---A Regulation to apply the
National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of
2000) to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas.
Whereas it is expedient to apply
the NADRA Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of 2000) to the Federally Administered Tribal
Areas;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
power conferred by clauses (3) and (5) of Article 247 of the Constitution of
the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, the President is pleased to make the
following Regulation.
1. Short title, extent and commencement.---(1) This Regulation may be called the
NADRA (Application to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation,
2005.
(i) It
extends to the whole of the FATA.
(ii) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Application of the NADRA
Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of 2000) to the FATA.---The NADRA
Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of 2000), as in force in Pakistan immediately before the
commencement of this Regulation and, so far as may be, all rules, regulations,
notifications, orders and instructions which may have been, or may be made or
issued thereunder, shall apply to the FATA.
***
